title: 第1358章 推演第1357章 新变化
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
四目道长正坐在屋檐下喝茶。
听到这里，脸色一变。
“我刚回来。”
九叔淡淡道：“你守任家镇。”
四目道长茶都喝不下去了。
“我就知道。”
文才小声道：“师叔，能者多劳。”
四目道长看向他。
文才立刻低头。
“我去扫地。”
林凡没有笑。
他在想顾安这次见他的用意。
外封点里，封着太多东西。
空灯灰。
四号灯。
旧香炉。
旧账拓影。
任府坏镜和旧灯。
还有部分灯芯灰。
这些东西，每一样都能牵出旧痕。

若分开放着还好。
若互相牵动，就会很麻烦。
林凡心里有一个判断。
顾安要见他，可能不是为了说七灯还一。
而是外封点里的封物出了问题。
“师父。”
林凡道。
“外封点有没有传来异常？”
九叔看他一眼。
“掌门没说。”
“只说顾安要见你。”
没说，不代表没有。
有些事在传讯符里不能说。
尤其涉及封物。
一念名，就可能牵动。
九叔显然也明白。
所以他没有多问。
两人很快准备出发。
林凡带了黑布、封咒纸、糯米、清水、红绳。
没有带太多雷符。

这次去的是外封点。
不是斗邪。
乱动雷，反而可能惊动封物。
秋生背上木箱。
content_en:
Taoist priest Simu was sitting under the eaves drinking tea.
Hearing this, his expression changed.
"I just came back."
Uncle Jiu said calmly: "You guard Renjia Town."
The four-eyed Taoist priest couldn't even drink the tea.
"I knew it."
Wencai whispered: "Uncle, those who are capable work harder."
Taoist Priest Four Eyes looked at him.
Wencai immediately lowered his head.
"I'm going to sweep the floor."
Lin Fan didn't smile.
He was thinking about Gu An's purpose in meeting him this time.
There are too many things sealed in the outer sealing point.
Empty lamp gray.
Light number four.
Old incense burner.
The shadow of old accounts.
Ren's house has broken mirrors and old lamps.
There is also some wick gray.
Each of these things can bring out old traces.
It would be better if they were kept separately.
If they interfere with each other, it will be very troublesome.
Lin Fan had a judgment in his mind.
Gu An wanted to see him, maybe not just to say seven lights for one.
But there is something wrong with the sealing material in the outer sealing point.
"Master."
Lin Fan said.
"Is there anything unusual coming from the outer sealing point?"
Uncle Jiu glanced at him.
"The leader didn't say anything."
"I just said that Gu An wants to see you."
Just because I didn’t say it doesn’t mean there isn’t one.
There are some things that cannot be said in the messenger.
Especially when it comes to seals.
Just mentioning the name may affect someone.
Uncle Jiu obviously understood.
So he didn't ask any more questions.
The two were soon ready to set off.
Lin Fan brought black cloth, curse paper, glutinous rice, water, and red rope.
I didn’t bring too many thunder talismans.
This time I went to Waifeng Point.
It's not a fight against evil.
If the thunder is stirred randomly, it may alarm the sealed objects.
Qiu Sheng carries the wooden box on his back.
